method_notes.repeated_cv_protocol: 10x10 Repeated Stratified Cross-Validation (RepeatedStratifiedKFold, n_splits=10, n_repeats=10, random_state=1) resulting in 100 paired evaluation folds.
method_notes.pairing_and_leakage: Exact identical train/test splits evaluated simultaneously across all algorithms (ZeroR, ID3, CART, GaussianNB, CategoricalNB, KNN, RF) for both Model A and Model B. Preprocessing (OneHotEncoder, ColumnTransformer, Scaler, Quantile Discretizer) strictly encapsulated within Pipeline objects fitted solely on training splits.
method_notes.hardware_optimization: To eliminate Windows OpenMP/loky worker thread exhaustion during 200 sequential subprocess spawns, repeated-CV significance testing used n_estimators=100 and n_jobs=1 with cloned pipelines. The full dataset (3,204 films) and complete candidate grids were strictly maintained without any reduction.
method_notes.calibration_protocol: Calibrated with CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid', cv=5, ensemble=False). Brier scores and reliability curves evaluated strictly out-of-fold via 10-fold cross_val_predict.

known_limitations: Model A uses strictly pre-release signals; commercial success remains subject to unforeseen viral marketing, competitor release date clashes, and critical word-of-mouth.
vote_count and popularity are post-release engagement snapshots (2017) and partly proxy for audience size, so Model B is explanatory, not a pre-release forecast.
44.5% of movies have first-time or unknown directors in this historical dataset, defaulting director past revenue to 0.
Historical TMDb data reflects box office economics up through 2017 and may not capture post-2020 day-and-date streaming distribution shifts.
Franchise is defined per TMDb collection; shared universes (e.g. The Avengers 2012 after Iron Man) are not captured, so such films count as originals.
